subject.title: feat(config): add canonical group-policy scope-tree resolver

question: Should ScopeTree and all three resolvers become a permanent public channel-policy SDK contract now, or remain core-internal until bundled channel migrations prove and stabilize the API?
rationale: The PR deliberately adds six public exports with no production caller, while the existing adapter context cannot preserve channel-scoped sender-policy behavior without an additional provider identity contract.

options.title: Stabilize before public export
options.body: Require channel/provider identity, add parity coverage and real migrated-channel proof, then publish the proven narrow SDK surface.

options.title: Keep it core-internal first
options.body: Land the canonical resolver without public exports, migrate bundled channels, and promote the final API after the caller shape settles.

options.title: Accept the proposed contract
options.body: Publish the current six-export surface and require every channel migration to supply messageProvider through separate plumbing.

recommendation.title: Stabilize before public export
recommendation.body: Require channel/provider identity, add parity coverage and real migrated-channel proof, then publish the proven narrow SDK surface.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the current refactor and also appear in the merged history of the sender-policy behavior whose public contract is being changed.
